definition: "Sports wager" means a wager placed on an authorized sporting event.
"Oddsmaker" means a person licensed as a casino key employee or a casino service industry enterprise responsible for the final approval of all odds established on any wager.
"Event number" means a set of alpha and/or numeric characters that correspond to specific odds for a sports event.
"Parlays combine a number of bets on events, called 'legs.' Bettors place bets on two or more legs, which are then combined into a single parlay bet. Players must win all legs to win a parlay."
The report classifies 'straight bets' as moneyline, point spread, and total (over/under), either whole-game or partial.
The report lists 'Prop' as a distinct bet type in its bet-type and loss-percentage tables.
